name: Reels
hook_strategy: pattern interrupt and face/text hook in first 1-2 seconds
visual_requirements: Vertical framing; dynamic cuts; on-screen text safe margins
audio_requirements: Trending-friendly music bed; clear voice if talking; strong beat sync optional
notes: Optimize for mobile vertical scroll discovery.

name: Shorts
caption_style: burned-in captions, concise hooks, keyword emphasis
hook_strategy: immediate curiosity gap or bold claim grounded in content
visual_requirements: Vertical 9:16; tight framing; frequent visual changes
audio_requirements: Clear dialogue priority; light music under voice

name: Explainer
caption_style: clear section labels; key terms on screen
hook_strategy: state the problem then promise a clear explanation
visual_requirements: Diagrams, B-roll of concepts, simple motion graphics overlays
audio_requirements: Calm authoritative VO; minimal music distraction

name: Educational
caption_style: step markers; numbered tips; readable body text
hook_strategy: what you will learn in this clip
visual_requirements: Demo footage, screen overlays, step-by-step visuals
audio_requirements: Clear instructional voice; pause for key steps

name: Talking Head
caption_style: word-level captions under speaker; high readability
hook_strategy: direct-to-camera opener with a strong statement
visual_requirements: Stable framing on speaker; eye-level; clean background
audio_requirements: Primary focus on voice; light ambience only

name: Vlog
hook_strategy: where we are / what today is about
visual_requirements: Handheld or natural movement; lifestyle B-roll; jump cuts
audio_requirements: Natural ambient + clear narration

name: Cinematic
caption_style: minimal captions; elegant typography if used
hook_strategy: visual mood first; delayed verbal reveal
visual_requirements: Color graded shots; intentional composition; slow motion optional
audio_requirements: Score-driven; sparse dialogue; high production sound

name: Storytelling
caption_style: narrative beats on screen; emotional emphasis
hook_strategy: open on conflict or unanswered question
visual_requirements: Scene progression; character/place continuity
audio_requirements: Narrative VO with supportive underscore

name: Documentary
hook_strategy: intriguing factual teaser or key interview line
visual_requirements: Interview + observational B-roll; archival if available
audio_requirements: Clean interview audio; subtle documentary score

name: Interview
caption_style: speaker names; pull-quotes for key answers
hook_strategy: best quote or surprising answer first
visual_requirements: A/B camera angles; reaction cutaways
audio_requirements: Isolated mics; minimal bed music

name: Podcast
caption_style: large captions for audio-first clips; speaker labels
hook_strategy: clip the sharpest claim or debate moment
visual_requirements: Waveform or static host visuals; simple brand frame
audio_requirements: Dialogue is primary; light intro sting only

name: Reaction
caption_style: reaction keywords; timestamps of peak moments
hook_strategy: show peak reaction face/line immediately
visual_requirements: Split or PIP of source + reactor; quick cuts
audio_requirements: Reactor voice clear over source audio ducked

name: Review
hook_strategy: verdict teaser then evidence
visual_requirements: Product close-ups; comparison shots; on-screen scores
audio_requirements: Clear reviewer VO; optional product SFX

name: Unboxing
hook_strategy: show the product promise before the box opens
visual_requirements: Hands + product focus; clean tabletop; reveal pacing
audio_requirements: ASMR-friendly packaging sounds + light VO

name: Comparison
hook_strategy: name the two options and the deciding factor
visual_requirements: Split screens; matched angles; criterion checklist
audio_requirements: Neutral VO; avoid biased music cues

name: News
hook_strategy: who/what/why in the first line
visual_requirements: B-roll of event; anchor or VO over footage
audio_requirements: Clear news VO; restrained bed

name: Motivational
hook_strategy: emotional thesis line up front
visual_requirements: Cinematic B-roll; slow push-ins; text overlays
audio_requirements: Uplifting score under VO

name: Faceless
caption_style: heavy on-screen text; captions carry story
hook_strategy: text hook + curiosity visual without face
visual_requirements: Stock/B-roll, screen, or abstract visuals; no face required
audio_requirements: VO or TTS primary; music bed supportive

name: Screen Recording
caption_style: UI callouts; cursor highlights; step numbers
hook_strategy: show the end result then rewind to steps
visual_requirements: Clean screen capture; zoom on clicks; cursor emphasis
audio_requirements: Instructional VO synced to actions

name: Animation
caption_style: integrated motion text; limited burned captions
hook_strategy: bold animated symbol or question
visual_requirements: Character or object animation; consistent art style
audio_requirements: Designed SFX + VO; music timed to beats

name: Motion Graphics
hook_strategy: start with the key stat or visual metaphor
visual_requirements: Infographic motion; clean brand shapes; data viz
audio_requirements: Corporate-clean bed; crisp VO

name: Whiteboard
hook_strategy: draw the question then solve it
visual_requirements: Whiteboard or sketch visuals; progressive reveals
audio_requirements: Teacher-style VO; marker SFX light

name: AI Avatar
hook_strategy: avatar speaks the core promise immediately
visual_requirements: Consistent avatar framing; simple background; lip-sync friendly cuts
audio_requirements: TTS or cloned voice clarity first; light bed

name: Kinetic Typography
caption_style: text IS the visual; timed word animations
hook_strategy: largest word lands on the strongest phrase
visual_requirements: Bold type motion; minimal footage or solid color beds
audio_requirements: Beat-synced music; VO optional

name: Montage
hook_strategy: best visual first; rhythm sells the cut
visual_requirements: Many short shots; match cuts; progressive intensity
audio_requirements: Music-driven; VO sparse

name: B-Roll
caption_style: minimal; support main VO if paired
hook_strategy: most evocative establishing shot first
visual_requirements: Supporting footage variety; texture and context shots
audio_requirements: Natural sound + optional underscore; VO usually external

name: Before/After
hook_strategy: tease the after then show the before contrast
visual_requirements: Matched framing for compare; wipe or split transition
audio_requirements: Impact SFX on reveal; short VO

name: Case Study
caption_style: problem → approach → result labels; metrics on screen
hook_strategy: lead with measurable outcome
visual_requirements: Charts, product UI, customer context B-roll
audio_requirements: Professional VO; restrained music

name: Testimonial
hook_strategy: strongest customer quote first
visual_requirements: Customer talking head + product/context B-roll
audio_requirements: Clear customer audio; soft bed

name: Advertisement
hook_strategy: attention + benefit in first 2 seconds
visual_requirements: Product hero shots; lifestyle proof; brand end card
audio_requirements: High-energy bed; punchy VO; legal disclaimers if needed

name: UGC
hook_strategy: authentic opener as if filming for a friend
visual_requirements: Phone-native framing; imperfect handheld OK; real environments
audio_requirements: Natural room tone; conversational mic

name: Live Stream
caption_style: highlight markers; chat-style callouts for clip cuts
hook_strategy: clip the peak live moment or announcement
visual_requirements: Live-style overlays; multi-cam if available
audio_requirements: Live mic clarity; crowd ambience controlled

name: Gaming
caption_style: kill/feed style callouts; meme text optional
hook_strategy: best play or fail first
visual_requirements: Gameplay capture; facecam optional PIP; zoom on action
audio_requirements: Game audio ducked under commentary

name: Travel
hook_strategy: destination beauty or surprising tip first
visual_requirements: Establishing landscapes; food; movement shots
audio_requirements: Ambient location sound + light VO/music

name: Fitness
hook_strategy: result or hardest move teaser
visual_requirements: Form-clear angles; before/after optional; gym/home setting
audio_requirements: Upbeat track; coach VO cues

name: Comedy
hook_strategy: setup that promises a punchline quickly
visual_requirements: Timing cuts; reaction shots; simple locations
audio_requirements: Clear punch delivery; laugh track avoided unless stylistic

name: Meme
hook_strategy: recognizable format + twist
visual_requirements: Template-friendly framing; reaction faces; green screen optional
audio_requirements: Viral audio bed when relevant

name: POV
hook_strategy: establish the POV scenario in one line
visual_requirements: First-person camera feel; immersive framing
audio_requirements: Close mic / immersive SFX

name: Day-in-the-Life
hook_strategy: most interesting part of the day first or morning promise
visual_requirements: Sequence of daily moments; transitions by time
audio_requirements: VO diary + lifestyle music

name: Behind-the-Scenes
hook_strategy: show the polished result then peel back the process
visual_requirements: Making-of shots; crew/process; candid framing
audio_requirements: Candid VO; set ambience; light music

name: Long-form
hook_strategy: cold open then thesis for the full piece
visual_requirements: Sustained sequences; varied shot sizes; section breaks
audio_requirements: Full mix: VO, score beds, ambient beds
notes: Legacy Long-form maps here; still usable as a preset.
